row.body: A seed bag is wrapped in a letter asking someone to leave before the field crew returns. The writer says the route is safer if no one waits at the door.
row.title: You have to leave

sidecar.gloss: A personal departure request is tied to a crew’s planned return.
sidecar.rival_reading: A containment order could have prompted the same departure request; the letter does not identify what the crew was doing.
